messages:
maya: Quick check — after PR #4827 merged the model-serving ConfigMap (model-flags) in staging doesn't seem to propagate to the model pods. Pods still have the old flag set. Anyone seen this before? :eyes:

oliver: Did TF apply run and succeed? or did the config get templated into a different namespace?

sam: I saw a failed apply earlier from the CI window, but I thought it retried. can you paste `kubectl get cm model-flags -n staging -o yaml`?

maya: pasted below. note updateTimestamp is 2026-03-17T12:05:00Z but pods show last mounted 2026-03-16.
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: model-flags
  namespace: staging
  annotations:
    terraform.io/last-apply: "2026-03-17T12:05:00Z"
data:
  enable_dynamic_routing: "true"
  default_batch_size: "8"
```

lucy: operator logs? If the configmap is updated but pods don't see it, either the sidecar that watches for configmap changes died or we changed the mount to use subPath (which breaks refresh). Any chance someone changed the mount pattern in deployment template?

infra-bot: Deploy 4827 by @maya passed CI, applied to staging cluster at 2026-03-17T12:08:42Z (plan -> apply).

sam: good call on subPath — I remember a recent change to the model container image that used subPath to avoid permission issues. subPath prevents automatic content reload when ConfigMap updates.

maya: ahhh that matches. PR 4801 updated container init logic and switched to `subPath: flags` to preserve file perms. I can revert to a symlink approach if we want live reload. Thoughts?

oliver: two options: (1) revert subPath -> live reload works but we need to fix perms inside init container, or (2) keep subPath and add a deployment rolling restart in the TF apply step (k8s_manifest resource or null_resource with kubectl). Option 2 is more explicit and lower risk.

sam: +1 for option 2 in short term. add a small `kubectl rollout restart deployment/model-serving -n staging` post-apply hook. then follow up to implement a proper init that sets file perms and removes subPath.

maya: I'll open a quick patch to TF to add a null_resource that runs the rollout restart as a local-exec post-apply. pinging @sam for review.

lucy: can you also add an entry to the runbook about this subPath caveat? Saved us time.

maya: yep — adding runbook note and the TF change. putting the PR up as draft now: #4832.

sam: reviewing now :eyes:

oliver: one more: add a smoke check after restart to ensure the model pods show UPDATED flag (kubectl exec grep or curl /health endpoint that prints loaded flags).

maya: will do, adding a small `kubectl exec` check in the null_resource. thanks everyone :pray:
thread_content_summary: ConfigMap updated in staging but pods not reflecting changes due to use of subPath; decided to add post-apply rollout restart and smoke check, follow-up to fix perms and remove subPath
